draft.title: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon
draft.description: Come and build the future of superintelligence. Ten days, access to our newest models and $1M in prizes. The Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon is virtual, worldwide and free to enter if selected. About the Hackathon Apply to spend ten days building with Meta's newest models. Use the Muse Spark series, Muse Wonder, Muse Image and SAM 3.1 through Meta Model API, run Meta open weights models, and code faster with Muse Code coding agent. Bring a problem you know firsthand, or an idea that feels out of reach. Build it with the models, learn from the Meta team and partners in live workshops, and compete for a share in the $1,000,000 cash prize pool across two tracks: one for indie developers and one for startups. Partners We have an amazing set of inference partners supporting the event: Baseten is offering $100 in credits and 2M TPM rate limits to select participants to use Meta's open-weights models. Modal is offering $100 in credits to select participants to use Meta's open-weights models through Endpoints in addition to their serverless GPUs, sandboxes, and tools for LLM training. Fireworks is offering $25 in credits to select participants to use Meta's open-weight models along with a workshop from Sinan Ozdemir Participant Tracks $1,000,000 in total prizes. Every project enters one track. Indie developer track: For individual builders and students. Judged on creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works. Startup track: For teams and founders building a real product. Judged on technical execution and whether it holds up in production. Project Themes Regardless of the track you choose, we’re looking for projects in two main themes: Build for Your World. Bring Meta's models into your domain. Solve a problem you know firsthand, free up time and mental space, and make something possible that wasn't before. Push the Frontier. Use Meta's models to tackle challenges in software, robotics, manufacturing, energy, materials and beyond. Give a machine a new capability, accelerate a scientific experiment, or unlock a better way to understand and control a physical system. Show us what becomes possible when these models meet the real world. Apply Now Apply to participate. Participation is limited to a maximum of 20,000 accepted applicants. Applications will be evaluated against the selection criteria below on a rolling basis. No further applications will be accepted or evaluated once the cap is reached. Organizers reserve the right, in their sole discretion, to close the application portal and end the application period immediately once the participant cap is satisfied, even if such date is prior to the posted Application Deadline. Early application is encouraged. Key Dates Oct 13, 9:00 AM ET: Applications open. Applications are reviewed, and applicants notified, on a rolling basis. Oct 25, 11:59 PM ET: Applications Deadline, or earlier if all 20,000 spots are filled. Oct 26, 9:00 AM ET: Applicant approval notification sent by this time Oct 26: Hackathon begins with kickoff livestream Oct 27 – Nov 4: Live workshops from Meta and partners, plus office hours on Discord Nov 4: Project submissions due by 9:00 PM ET Nov 4 – Nov 8: Judging Nov 9: Closing ceremony - live finals and winners announced *Dates may be subject to change at Meta’s sole discretion. Any change will be posted on this page. How Applications are Reviewed We aim for a mix of technical backgrounds and domains across participants. Applicants should best showcase their technical skills in the application form. We review every application against two criteria, using only your answers on the application form: Your project idea: how clear and feasible your proposed project is, and how well it fits one of the two project themes. Your technical skill: the technical skill shown in the AI project you describe, including what you built and the techniques you used. Links to your GitHub, LinkedIn or a shipped product help us verify your experience and skill but are not required. Bot
